section_2_cross_root_profile.explicit_warning: a profile that SEPARATES roots' boundaries into distinct-looking groups is not thereby a MINIMAL profile, and matching profiles across two states does not license treating them as continuation-equivalent. section_3_generalization_tests.statement: all roots reproduce only known-18 classes
section_3_generalization_tests.significance: moderate -- consistent with (not proof of) the RR-branch's Target-A-abundant/Target-B-empty pattern extending to the short-root family
section_3_generalization_tests.next_proof_task: attempt a structural (not merely empirical) argument for why -- a theorem connecting short-root R2 geometry to known-18's defining structure, not yet attempted

section_3_generalization_tests.statement: roots produce new Target A classes but all Target-B close
section_3_generalization_tests.significance: moderate-to-high -- new geometric structure exists, relevant to later Target C/NR6 questions, while Target B stays empty with fresh witnesses

section_3_generalization_tests.next_proof_task: exhaustively re-verify the survivor; attempt extension to a full Target-C/NR6 completion; re-audit every capacity theorem/helper used along the way

section_3_generalization_tests.statement: one root has no R1 admission in the tested normal form

lemmas.statement: for every short root r and every Target A boundary b reachable from r, canonicalize(b) is left-S6-equal to canonicalize(b') for some b' in the known-18 corpus
lemmas.necessary_evidence: exhaustive (not bounded) Target-A search from all 5 roots, or a structural argument independent of search
lemmas.likely_counterexample_pattern: a boundary reached via a longer repair chain opening enough fresh orbits/hexagons to reach a canonical form outside the small known-18 corpus
lemmas.hand_proof_route: a bijection/quotient argument showing short-root R2-recognition geometry is structurally forced into known-18's finite canonical-form set -- does not exist yet
lemmas.finite_certificate_route: exhaustively enumerate all Target-A boundaries from all 5 roots and check each against known-18 -- bounded pilots are a sample of this, not the certificate

lemmas.statement: short-root boundaries satisfy Phi=0 and R_cap=1 -- SPLIT into two claims of different epistemic status

part_a_ndef_equals_2.reason: the same +k-exactly identity Round 37's envelope theorem uses: Ndef(boundary)=Ndef(root)+k, k=2 for a bare short root, Ndef(root)=0
part_a_ndef_equals_2.hand_proof_route: direct citation of the Round 37 identity, no new proof needed

part_b_phi_equals_0.reason: Phi depends on rotation-run lengths along the specific path taken, not on Ndef/R-event accounting, so nothing forces it a priori
part_b_phi_equals_0.necessary_evidence: check Phi(b)=0 for every boundary found across all 5 roots, not just the one instance confirmed so far
part_b_phi_equals_0.likely_counterexample_pattern: a boundary reached via ell=5 at every step except one short step elsewhere in the path (not the R2 edge itself) leaving Phi>0 at the boundary
part_b_phi_equals_0.finite_certificate_route: cheap, deterministic -- read directly off already-exported per-boundary telemetry

lemmas.note_on_r_cap_label: whether Ndef=2 should be read as 'R_cap=1' additionally depends on treating n_limit=3 as the reference constant -- now understood (Round 41) as a Target-B/Area-A-scope convention, not an intrinsic Target-A property. The lemma is two separate claims wearing one name and should not be evaluated as a single unit.

lemmas.statement: every short-root R1 preparation is a phase truncation of one orbit spine -- there is a single E-orbit q* (or small canonical family) such that R1 alternatives are successive Z2-preparation-depth choices along one spine through q*'s phases
lemmas.necessary_evidence: short_ell0 exhibits this; needs the same check for short_ell1-short_ell4
lemmas.likely_counterexample_pattern: a root where more than one independent preparation spine exists (branching earlier than a single shared prefix)
lemmas.hand_proof_route: showing, from the fixed move table and new_orbit/ORBIT_PHASE structure, that exactly one Z2-continuation is legal at each preparation depth from any bare short root -- not yet attempted
lemmas.finite_certificate_route: direct inspection of the legal successor set at each preparation depth for all 5 roots -- cheap; partially done already (all 5 roots share an identical legal_first_macro_edges list from Round 36)

grades.HAND_THEOREM: a proved, general statement with a complete argument, root-independent unless explicitly scoped
grades.EXACT_EXHAUSTIVE_CERTIFICATE: a specific, bounded question decided by a search verified non-truncated
grades.CORRECTED_BOUNDED_OBSERVATION: a real, reproducible fact about a specific capped run -- informative, not exhaustive
grades.CORPUS_SPECIFIC_SYMMETRY_MEASUREMENT: an empirical measurement taken over one specific, finite corpus -- not a general symmetry theorem
grades.REFUTED_CONJECTURE: a specific claim shown false, with the exact counterexample recorded
grades.OPEN: genuinely undecided; no evidence yet in either direction
